raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst
PayCorp Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
April 2024 – Present
Project: NPCI Mandates & Payment Platform (NACH, UPI Autopay, APBS)
Responsibilities
Led end-to-end requirement gathering for NPCI payment platforms supporting
NACH, UPI Autopay, e-Mandate, Paper Mandates and Aadhaar-based services. • Managed complete mandate lifecycle including onboarding, validation, execution,
reconciliation and exception handling.
Prepared BRD, FRD/FSD, solution scope documents and business process flows
aligned with NPCI and banking regulations.
Designed inward and outward payment flows covering authentication, settlement,
consent management and reversals.
Used Python (Pandas) along with SQL to perform payment data validation, reconcile
transaction datasets, automate data quality checks, and generate analytical datasets for Power BI reporting and business insight
Coordinated with banks, NPCI and internal stakeholders during UAT, certification,
audit readiness and production deployment.
Supported onboarding of more than 1 million payment records, achieving 99%+
mandate success rate after go-live.
Project: API-Driven Rent Collection & Mandate Platform
Gathered and analyzed business requirements for API integrations between Core
Banking Systems, partner platforms and Sohar International Bank.
Performed interface analysis and data mapping for secure system integrations. • Worked closely with Product, Business and Development teams throughout

delivery. Improved mandate execution turnaround by 30–40% through optimized API workflows.
Configured and validated APIs using Postman. • Supported deployment and production stabilization activities.
Project: Regulatory, Audit & Information Security Compliance
Supported VAPT, SOC2, ISO 27001:2022 and PCI DSS audit programs. • Coordinated with auditors and internal stakeholders for evidence collection and audit closure.
Ensured compliance with NPCI, UIDAI and regulatory standards. • Achieved 100% audit closure with zero critical observations.
Business Analyst
Baroda Global Shared Services Ltd.
March 2021 – April 2024
Responsibilities
Gathered and documented business requirements for Payments and Trade Finance
solutions.
Conducted gap analysis for International Wire Payments using SWIFT MT103. • Worked on cross-border payment initiatives and data mapping activities.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops involving Business, Technology and Vendors. • Enhanced banking applications by integrating Forex, Loans, Insurance and Reinsurance services.
Prepared functional specifications and supported end-to-end solution delivery.
Business Analyst Intern
Innodatatics Inc.
February 2020 – February 2021
Project: Term Deposit Subscription Analytics
Business Problem
The bank experienced declining revenue due to reduced customer term deposit subscriptions.
Responsibilities
Performed problem identification and requirement gathering. • Prepared functional documentation. • Extracted customer data using SQL. • Exported database records into CSV for analytical processing. • Built Power BI dashboards. • Used Python for data analysis and insight generation. • Supported testing and solution implementation.
Business Analyst
Axis Bank Ltd.
June 2018 – January 2020
Responsibilities
Managed HNI customer portfolio. • Promoted banking products including Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Credit Cards.
Handled NEFT, RTGS, CASA and Forex services. • Used Excel for customer portfolio management and reporting.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Requirement Gathering • Business Requirement Analysis • BRD / FRD / FSD Preparation • Stakeholder Management • Gap Analysis • Functional Specification Documentation • API Requirement Analysis • Process Flow Design • SQL-based Data Validation • Power BI Reporting • UAT Planning & Coordination • Production Go-Live Support • Banking & Payment Process Analysis • Regulatory Compliance • Audit Coordination
